_doc: Fragment for site/data/weir.json. Leaves are [v, unit, status, src, note] and are expanded by tools/data/build.mjs into {v, unit, status, src, note}. Levels in project EL. Local frame: x metres along the axis from the left (west) abutment face toward the right (east) bank; y metres along the flow, + downstream (north), - upstream (south).

meta.frame: x along the axis from the left (west) abutment face to the right (east) bank; y along the flow, positive downstream (north). Levels in project EL; model metres = EL + params.datum.offset_m.
meta.bank_convention: left and right looking downstream; the river flows south to north, so left = west (Keromongan), right = east (Perjaya)

lon: centre of the OpenStreetMap weir line
lat: centre of the OpenStreetMap weir line
bearing_deg: direction from the left (west) abutment to the right (east) abutment; the OSM line runs 104.38003,-4.30513 to 104.38198,-4.30510 (within 1 deg of 90)
flow_bearing_deg: the river crosses the weir flowing north (checked on the D8 flow grid)
length_m: abutment to abutment; the OSM line is 217 m and imagery 217 +/- 3 m (r08)

type: gated barrage (bendung gerak): all bays gated, no fixed overflow crest

left_width_m: what is left of 215.5 m after 177.5 m of gates and nine 3.0 m piers, split evenly between the two abutments

count: ten bays need nine piers between them
width_m: main bays 22.9 m centre to centre on imagery minus the 20.0 m gate; sluice bays 15.5 m minus 12.5 m

width_m.note: 38.0 m of non-gate length split over nine piers with no abutments (earlier settled assumption)
drawn for some piers on a blurry scan (R)

length_m: length along the flow of the pier and deck band including the hoist towers, 12 +/- 2 m
nose: rounded noses assumed (KP-02 pier coefficient 0.01 used for round piers)

bays_order_status: seven flood-gate bays from the left (west) bank, then the three sluice bays at the right (east) end
the narrow sluice bays are seen at the east end on imagery; which flood gates are FG1 to FG7 across the river, and which two are the 3.9 m high ones, is assumed (next to the sluices)

width_m: gate clear widths from the O&M manual via JICA 2019
gate_h_m: FG1-5 2.9 m, FG6-7 3.9 m, scouring sluice 4.2 m; which bays carry the 3.9 m gates is assumed
under_h_m: under-sluice leaf 12.5 x 2.0 m below each scouring sluice
sill_el: closed gate top at the normal pond 79.70 + 0.20 freeboard = 79.90; sill = 79.90 - gate height (2.9 m: 77.00; 3.9 m: 76.00); sluices: under-sluice floor = 75.70 - 2.0 = 73.70; no drawing found
basin_len_m: stilling basin lengths FG1-3 30 m (printed 330, a typo), FG4-7 40 m, sluice 50 m; imagery reads 20-25 m (r08)
upper_sill_el: sill of the upper (scouring) leaf = 79.90 - 4.2 = 75.70, on top of the 2.0 m under-sluice leaf

type_3d: vertical-lift roller gate with a flap on top
flaps from a student paper (weak); roller lift gates are the type of the 1981 design; hoist towers on every pier fit a lifting gate; real type not found
flap_h_m: height of the top flap leaf; the paper's flaps pass 9.36 m3/s in the first 0.1 m, no drawing found
colour_top: a thin orange-red line along all gate tops on aerials
lift_max_m: full lift clears the tallest leaf (4.2 m) out of the water with a 0.3 m margin

el: 2.0 m over the design high water EL 81.00; no drawing found
band_width_m: deck band including the hoist towers seen from above, 12 +/- 2 m
road_width_m: two-lane rural road (the secondary road crosses on the weir)
tower_footprint_m: each hoist tower about 6 x 8 m (+/- 2 m), one on each pier; grey concrete, flat grey roof
tower_height_m: above the deck: room to lift the tallest leaf clear plus the hoist housing; no drawing found

road: secondary road on the weir deck (OSM bridge 222 m)
length_m: OSM bridge way along the weir
railing_h_m: usual road railing height; not resolvable on imagery

between: on the pier between the flood bays and the sluice bays
upstream_m: about 50-68 m upstream (south) of the axis on imagery (the note's compass words are swapped, CONTRACT A1)
downstream_m: +/- 3 m downstream (north) of the axis (the note's compass words are swapped, CONTRACT A1)

floor_el: 1 m below the bed EL 74.0 at the axis, 0.7 m below the under-sluice floor

pond_normal_el: normal pond held by the gates: the intake water level of the O&M spec sheet (CONTRACT A5)
design_high_water_el: reached only in the design flood with every gate open
pond_min_intake_el: one 0.1 m gate step under the normal pond 79.70: the lowest pond at which the intake is still taken as giving its design flow
riverbed_el: bed at the weir axis in the 1981 design's own project datum: crest 79.30 minus height 5.3; the Manning section below the weir uses tail_bed_el instead
tailwater_flood_case_el: downstream level in the paper's overflow case (weak)
tail_bed_el: replaced by build.mjs: the bed for which the Manning section gives the design tail EL 80.00 at 2,200 m3/s

bank: office, settling basins and canal head all lie east of the weir
x_m: centre about 10 m beyond the right abutment, along the east bank
y_m: centre about 30 m upstream of the axis in the pocket behind the divide wall; a gated bank structure about 54 m long is seen there
face_bearing_deg: gates face west into the pond pocket; channels run east then curve north (r08)
leaves: slide-gate leaves; about 6 housings are seen on the photo (r08)
sill_el: 79.70 - 0.20 lip cover - 1.17 m opening; opening = 91.68 / (0.80 x 49.5 x sqrt(2g x 0.20)) = 1.17 m (KP-02 eq 5-3)
design_wl_el: intake design water level = normal pond (CONTRACT A5)

capacity_m3s.note: Phase I design and operator figure, kept as the operating target

feed_channels: four parallel concrete-lined channels run east then north
gate_h_m: from the sill 78.30 up to the design high water 81.00, so the closed intake holds the flood

count: 3 built in Phase I, 2 added in Phase II
centre: Bak Desilting Perjaya, right bank just below the weir
width_m: imagery: bulbs about 44 +/- 4 m wide, 50 m centre to centre (r08)
long_axis_bearing_deg: basins run along the flow; their downstream (north) ends join a collector

slot: between SG3 and the right abutment
east side is sourced; the exact slot is not

point: start of the OSM irrigation canal toward Belitang
Kantor O&P SDA II Bendung Perjaya, right bank
